# Open-Logistics

> Open-Logistics is a free, MIT-licensed SDK for the Shiprocket, Delhivery, iThink Logistics, and Shadowfax APIs. It ships a typed TypeScript SDK on npm plus generated Python and Rust clients, covering orders, shipments, tracking, rates, serviceability, waybills, labels, manifests, pickups, and normalized errors. The recommended TypeScript entry point is `OpenLogistics`, which selects a provider at construction and uses one resource surface for any vendor.

## Key facts

- Providers: Shiprocket, Delhivery, iThink Logistics, and Shadowfax (India).
- Languages: TypeScript, Python, and Rust.
- TypeScript entry points: `OpenLogistics` (recommended, provider-agnostic) and the `Shiprocket` / `Delhivery` / `Ithink` / `Shadowfax` facades (all deprecated, kept for two more releases).
- Provider selection: pass `provider: "shiprocket" | "delhivery" | "ithink" | "shadowfax"` to `new OpenLogistics(...)`. One instance talks to one provider; there is no registry, fallback chain, or automatic routing.
- Resource mapping: `orders`, `shipments`, `tracking`, and `rates` exist on all providers; `courier` is Shiprocket-only; `serviceability` is provided by Delhivery, iThink, and Shadowfax; `waybills` is provided by Delhivery and Shadowfax. Resources a provider does not offer are `undefined`.
- License: MIT. No paid tier.
- Shiprocket auth: email and password; token cached in memory and refreshed on HTTP 401, with no cap on refreshes.
- Delhivery auth: static API token plus registered client name; no refresh flow.
- iThink auth: static `access_token` plus `secret_key` sent in each request body; no refresh flow.
- iThink errors: a failure can arrive as HTTP 200 with `status: "error"` or `status_code >= 400`; tracking, rates, and serviceability throw `IthinkAPIError`, while orders, cancellation, and documents return `success: false`. Batches above the limits (10 AWBs tracking, 10 shipments create, 100 AWBs cancel or label) throw `Error` before the request.
- Shadowfax auth: static API token; no refresh flow in the SDK (OAuth2 client credentials are not implemented).
- Shadowfax gotcha: forward order creation returns HTTP 200 for rejections; check `success` / `message`.
- Errors: all classes include the HTTP status; `ShiprocketAPIError` adds provider field errors, `DelhiveryAPIError`, `IthinkAPIError`, and `ShadowfaxAPIError` add the parsed response body.
- Repository: https://github.com/kush34/open-logistics

## Packages

- npm: `open-logistics`
- PyPI: `open-logistics-sdk` (import name `open_logistics`)
- crates.io: `open-logistics`

## Quick start

- TypeScript (recommended): `npm install open-logistics`, then `new OpenLogistics({ provider: "shiprocket", email, password })`, `new OpenLogistics({ provider: "delhivery", token, clientName })`, `new OpenLogistics({ provider: "ithink", accessToken, secretKey })`, or `new OpenLogistics({ provider: "shadowfax", token })`, then call `openLogistics.orders.create(payload)`, `openLogistics.tracking.byAWB(awb)` (Shiprocket), or `openLogistics.tracking.byWaybill(waybill)` (Delhivery, iThink, Shadowfax).
- TypeScript (direct clients): `new ShiprocketClient({ email, password })`, `new DelhiveryClient({ token, clientName })`, `new IthinkClient({ accessToken, secretKey })`, or `new ShadowfaxClient({ token })`.
- Python: `pip install open-logistics-sdk`, then `from open_logistics.shiprocket import ApiClient, AuthApi, AuthCredentials, Configuration`. Each provider has its own module (`shiprocket`, `delhivery`, `ithink`, `shadowfax`).
- Rust: `cargo add open-logistics`, then use `open_logistics::shiprocket::apis`. The same per-provider modules exist under `open_logistics::`.

## Documentation

- [OpenLogistics client](https://open-logistics.vercel.app/getting-started/open-logistics): provider selection, per-provider resource matrix, switching providers, backward compatibility, and migration.
- [Installation](https://open-logistics.vercel.app/getting-started/installation): install commands, runtime requirements, and package names for npm, PyPI, and crates.io.
- [Python and Rust clients](https://open-logistics.vercel.app/languages/): generated client imports, authentication, method-name mapping, and differences from TypeScript.

### Shiprocket

- [Shiprocket overview](https://open-logistics.vercel.app/shiprocket/): provider capabilities, auth model, guides, and examples.
- [Shiprocket authentication](https://open-logistics.vercel.app/shiprocket/getting-started/authentication): email/password login, token caching, and refresh on 401.
- [Shiprocket configuration](https://open-logistics.vercel.app/shiprocket/getting-started/configuration): constructor options and base URL override.
- [Shiprocket client](https://open-logistics.vercel.app/shiprocket/api/client): the `ShiprocketClient` entry point and method list.
- [Shiprocket orders](https://open-logistics.vercel.app/shiprocket/api/orders): create, list, fetch, and cancel orders.
- [Shiprocket shipments](https://open-logistics.vercel.app/shiprocket/api/shipments): shipment, pickup, and manifest methods.
- [Shiprocket courier](https://open-logistics.vercel.app/shiprocket/api/courier): courier serviceability and rate checks.
- [Shiprocket tracking](https://open-logistics.vercel.app/shiprocket/api/tracking): track shipments by AWB.
- [Shiprocket rates](https://open-logistics.vercel.app/shiprocket/api/rates): rate calculation parameters and responses.
- [Shiprocket errors](https://open-logistics.vercel.app/shiprocket/api/errors): `ShiprocketAPIError` fields and handling.
- [Shiprocket orders guide](https://open-logistics.vercel.app/shiprocket/guides/orders): end-to-end order workflow.
- [Shiprocket shipments guide](https://open-logistics.vercel.app/shiprocket/guides/shipments): shipment workflow.
- [Shiprocket tracking guide](https://open-logistics.vercel.app/shiprocket/guides/tracking): tracking workflow.
- [Shiprocket label generation](https://open-logistics.vercel.app/shiprocket/guides/label-generation): label and pickup generation.
- [Shiprocket rate comparison](https://open-logistics.vercel.app/shiprocket/guides/rate-comparison): compare courier rates.
- [Shiprocket create-order example](https://open-logistics.vercel.app/shiprocket/examples/create-order): full order payload.
- [Shiprocket tracking example](https://open-logistics.vercel.app/shiprocket/examples/tracking): AWB tracking example.

### Delhivery

- [Delhivery overview](https://open-logistics.vercel.app/delhivery/): provider capabilities, auth model, guides, and examples.
- [Delhivery authentication](https://open-logistics.vercel.app/delhivery/getting-started/authentication): static token and client name.
- [Delhivery configuration](https://open-logistics.vercel.app/delhivery/getting-started/configuration): constructor options and base URL override.
- [Delhivery API reference](https://open-logistics.vercel.app/delhivery/api/): resource index and facade methods.
- [Delhivery client](https://open-logistics.vercel.app/delhivery/api/client): the `DelhiveryClient` entry point.
- [Delhivery orders](https://open-logistics.vercel.app/delhivery/api/orders): create, edit, and cancel B2C orders.
- [Delhivery shipments](https://open-logistics.vercel.app/delhivery/api/shipments): packing slips and pickup requests.
- [Delhivery tracking](https://open-logistics.vercel.app/delhivery/api/tracking): track by waybill or order ID.
- [Delhivery rates](https://open-logistics.vercel.app/delhivery/api/rates): invoice-based charge estimates.
- [Delhivery serviceability](https://open-logistics.vercel.app/delhivery/api/serviceability): pincode serviceability checks.
- [Delhivery waybills](https://open-logistics.vercel.app/delhivery/api/waybills): single and bulk waybill fetch.
- [Delhivery guide](https://open-logistics.vercel.app/delhivery/guides/): supported operations and known gaps.
- [Delhivery create-order example](https://open-logistics.vercel.app/delhivery/examples/create-order): full B2C shipment payload.

### iThink Logistics

- [iThink overview](https://open-logistics.vercel.app/ithink/): provider capabilities, auth model, guides, and examples.
- [iThink authentication](https://open-logistics.vercel.app/ithink/getting-started/authentication): static access token and secret key.
- [iThink configuration](https://open-logistics.vercel.app/ithink/getting-started/configuration): constructor options, staging and production hosts, and base URL override.
- [iThink API reference](https://open-logistics.vercel.app/ithink/api/): resource index and facade methods.
- [iThink client](https://open-logistics.vercel.app/ithink/api/client): the `IthinkClient` entry point.
- [iThink orders](https://open-logistics.vercel.app/ithink/api/orders): create, cancel, and bulk-cancel orders.
- [iThink shipments](https://open-logistics.vercel.app/ithink/api/shipments): labels and manifests.
- [iThink tracking](https://open-logistics.vercel.app/ithink/api/tracking): track by AWB.
- [iThink rates](https://open-logistics.vercel.app/ithink/api/rates): per-courier rate comparison.
- [iThink serviceability](https://open-logistics.vercel.app/ithink/api/serviceability): pincode serviceability per courier.
- [iThink guide](https://open-logistics.vercel.app/ithink/guides/): supported operations and known gaps.
- [iThink create-order example](https://open-logistics.vercel.app/ithink/examples/create-order): full order payload.
### Shadowfax

- [Shadowfax overview](https://open-logistics.vercel.app/shadowfax/): forward-logistics capabilities, auth model, guides, and out-of-scope products.
- [Shadowfax authentication](https://open-logistics.vercel.app/shadowfax/getting-started/authentication): static token; OAuth2 is not implemented.
- [Shadowfax configuration](https://open-logistics.vercel.app/shadowfax/getting-started/configuration): constructor options and staging/production base URLs.
- [Shadowfax API reference](https://open-logistics.vercel.app/shadowfax/api/): resource index and facade methods.
- [Shadowfax client](https://open-logistics.vercel.app/shadowfax/api/client): the `ShadowfaxClient` entry point.
- [Shadowfax orders](https://open-logistics.vercel.app/shadowfax/api/orders): create, update, and cancel forward orders, including HTTP 200 failures.
- [Shadowfax shipments](https://open-logistics.vercel.app/shadowfax/api/shipments): label generation and proof-of-delivery details.
- [Shadowfax tracking](https://open-logistics.vercel.app/shadowfax/api/tracking): track one or up to 50 orders.
- [Shadowfax rates](https://open-logistics.vercel.app/shadowfax/api/rates): rate calculator for a pincode pair.
- [Shadowfax serviceability](https://open-logistics.vercel.app/shadowfax/api/serviceability): per-leg pincode checks.
- [Shadowfax waybills](https://open-logistics.vercel.app/shadowfax/api/waybills): pooled, fresh, and polled AWB generation.
- [Shadowfax guide](https://open-logistics.vercel.app/shadowfax/guides/): supported operations and known gaps.
- [Shadowfax create-order example](https://open-logistics.vercel.app/shadowfax/examples/create-order): full forward order payload.

### Concepts and advanced behavior

- [Architecture](https://open-logistics.vercel.app/concepts/architecture): provider facades, resource modules, clients, and shared types.
- [Normalization](https://open-logistics.vercel.app/concepts/normalization): what the SDK normalizes and what stays raw.
- [Error model](https://open-logistics.vercel.app/concepts/error-model): error classes, fields, and status codes.
- [Providers](https://open-logistics.vercel.app/concepts/providers): why there is no runtime provider registry.
- [Error handling](https://open-logistics.vercel.app/advanced/error-handling): catch and inspect provider errors.
- [Retries](https://open-logistics.vercel.app/advanced/retries): the Shiprocket 401 refresh-and-retry and what is not retried.
- [Performance](https://open-logistics.vercel.app/advanced/performance): token caching, no polling, fetch-based requests.
